result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days. It was formatting `loc180Days` instead of `loc90Days`. The fix is one word, on line 906 of `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`.

I didn't compile or run any tests. `loc90Days` was already computed in that method (line 890) and was already used for the percentage, so the block's LOC, count and percentage now all use the 90-day set.
